hero.heading: Club calendar
hero.intro: Find a regular game or see upcoming dated events. Event registrations are managed through Signup.com.

regular.heading: Regular sessions
regular.text: Our weekly games run Monday to Friday. There are standard, abridged and starter sessions for a range of experience levels.

events.heading: Event signups
events.text: Use the club’s Signup.com page for current event registration details.

competition.heading: 2026 competition calendar
competition.text: See the full year of special events and competitions.

hosts.heading: Host signups
hosts.text: Hosts make sure players who arrive without a partner can join a partnership.

note: Event dates and registration details can change. Check Signup.com for current registration information.
